I don't see much of a difference yet, but I don't see any worsening, either. It's pasty, and doesn't really foam at all. At first, I thought it was a spot treatment or a mask, but a cleanser. The bottle is fairly large, and it doesn't have much of a scent, both positives.

I've used this product for a while and I can definately say I see a difference. I've always struggled with static acne and this is like a breath mint for my face. I use it at least 2x a day and it really works and leaves a clean feeling finish. The packaging is great, the only thing I would change is the lid—it's a little small and difficult to open sometimes in the shower. I've used products like this in the past and this one is my favorite. Be careful when using as to not bleach towels and clothes when drying face!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I use this as a spot treatment and cleanser, does not leave my skin dry at all. When using as a spot treatment I wake up and my acne has reduced greatly. Not a strong scent so it's perfect for those with sensitive skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've had such a good experience with this cleansing paste. Sometimes I get hormonal breakouts and this helped dry them out without making my skin feel super dry. It's not something I would use daily because my skin is more on the dry side naturally but overall, really great product. Happy to have gotten the chance to try it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Not the best photos I could've taken, but definitely organic lol. I had some breakouts on my chin after shaving. And a few natural pimples popping up on my forehead. I used the acne treating cleansing paste as a spot mask. I found it a bit difficult to apply to a small area. As it didn't want to stick, I had to then spread instead of dabbing it to make sure I could get enough applied on the areas. I left it on for around a 35 minute drive as I left my house to go to a friends. Upon arriving, I washed it off in the bathroom using my hands. I would definitely recommend using a cloth to make sure it comes off efficiently. Looking at my acne post mask, I could definitely see that it was working its magic and reducing inflammation while bringing the grime to the surface.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I used this cleansing paste for a week and noticed my skin felt cleaner and less oily without feeling dry. I like that it works as a cleanser, spot treatment, and mask, so it saves time and space. The texture is smooth and easy to apply, and it rinses off well. My breakouts looked calmer and less red after a few days.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I can't believe with only single use it has helped me reduce redness and pain of my active pimples. The fact that it got 2% salicylic acid make this product work so well. Unlike other acne products this does not smell like chemical but have shooting coconut smell and it's gentle to my skin. Packaging can be better with pump tube but it's definitely travel friendly. This product 100% works.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall a really good cleaner. I took before and after photos and they unfortunately didn't show much difference but I personal think my skin looks and feels better after using it for the last 3 weeks. It's sort of a think foamy texture and it has a nice light clean scent. I still have a lot of scarring and hyperpigmentation but I feel like I notice less active breakouts when I use this. The tube is also a lot bigger than initially expected, so it feels like it'll last for a while even with daily use. I did try it twice as a mask, it doesn't feel drying which is nice and I do feel like my skin looked better the next morning. I think I'll primarily use it as a cleanser though.

It's not too bad! Lathers well, smells pretty decent, and the results were okay. It felt like most face washes I've used, I don't love the small cap on this, I normally wash my face in the shower and handling this packaging in the shower while wet isn't the easiest.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As with all Kiehl's products I have nothing bad to say. As a cleanser, mask, or spot treatment this stuff is awesome! There's no weird scent or stickiness, and the product foams up and rinses off great as a cleanser. Using the product as a mask also surprisingly doesn't dry out your skin as long as you follow the instructions which is suprising for a salicylic acid cleanser. My favorite way to use this is as a spot treatment and after a couple applications there was noticeable improvement in acne with no drying or redness. I would definitely recommend this as a much less harsh alternative to products such as Clearasil. Notable bonus for not having peroxide and not having to deal with bleached sheets or towels when using this!

This is a great product. It helps myself and my acne prone teens in so many ways. It prevents breakouts and helps the others heal quick. I have never had such a nice skin in my life. The texture lathers up so well so you can get all the hard to reach areas.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product I actually love! I love that it has more than one function. Being able to use it as a spot treatment is wonderful. I've also added it to my Sunday routine as a mask! The clay smell doesn't bother me at all. Something about it lets me know my face is really being treated. It will cause dryness so I don't over use it on a daily basis because I already have dry skin

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My son is 17yrs old and has being using other well known products for over a year for his acne and skin issues. This Kiehl's Acne paste is his new favorite and he won't use anything else. We went on vacation and didn't packing and had to pick up a tube there! It has helped substantially and quickly with his acne flare ups for sure!

avis.titre: Clears breakouts fast, gentle on skin.
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this product for 2 weeks and really like it. It doesn't dry out my skin like many other salicylic acid products. The texture is soft and creamy, and it washes off easily without leaving that tight, uncomfortable feeling. I'm not sure how it would work for severe acne, but for small breakouts it's amazing — they usually clear up in just 2–3 days.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product worked great on my spots and blemishes! I don't struggle a whole lot with acne but I get blemishes here and there and this cleared them right up. I would definitely repurchase. No funky scent and a good thick texture, easy to apply.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was a little skeptical of this because how could it be a face mask, spot treatment, and a cleanser all in one? But when I used it, I kind of understood better. I wish the directions of how to properly use it as a cleanser were on the bottle or on the packaging, I did need to Google it to see how to properly activate it. You really need to lather it up vigorously which is a little annoying. However, I slapped it on my face and also let it sit while doing a few other steps in my night routine, and my face felt really nice and clean, but not stripped either. I used it last night, knowing I had a pimple or two, and I woke up with them gone!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] now I totally get that this is essentially clay in a bottle, but the scent is pretty strong considering it can be a mask that you're supposed to leave on for minutes at a time. getting past the scent, this is actually a really gentle cleanser and the salicylic acid in it doesn't burn whatsoever, thank goodness! the packaging is pretty large, so it looks like it would last quite a while as well :)

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Gentle acne face wash. It's not drying like some acne treatments can be. It is a think grey paste like consistency. A little goes a long way. For my active breaks outs it does help calm down the inflammation.
Such a good size bottle and a good product! Really lived up to my expectations. The texture is kinda clay like and it really worked to keep my skin hydrated as well as clean!

I really liked this. I get really bad acne, but every product I have tried dries my face out so bad after just one use. This smelled like coconut oil, and it was just such an amazing product. It said to use twice a day and I did, even though I was worried about it drying out my face, and it never did. It really did help clear up my acne too, like within a couple days of using it I saw a big difference. My skin felt so moisturized and clean.

avis.titre: It should be rinsed very well.
avis.texte: I've been using Kiehl's Gently Effective Acne-Treating Cleansing Paste for a few weeks now, and the results are amazing. From the first use, my skin felt cleaner and smoother. It helps dry out pimples without irritating or over-drying, thanks to its formula with salicylic acid, charcoal, and clay. It also contains centella asiatica, which soothes the skin. I love that it's gentle yet effective, and doesn't leave that tight, dry feeling. Perfect for combination or acne-prone skin. I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: Kiehls comes thru with another great skincare product
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great product! Kiehls always comes thru with skincare products that work well. I like using this the most as an overnight spot treatment for pimples that pop up during the day. They're noticeably smaller and less irritated after I rinse the product off the next morning. Packaged great, a good amount of product for the money, and doesn't have any weird fragrance. Not harsh and works well.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product was very nice for acne prone skin. Usually Salicylic acid breaks me out, but using this as a face wash was actually very gentle. I did not use it as a spot treatment or mask but I'm sure it's good for that as well. I really enjoyed this product overall!

avis.titre: Very helpful for my acne prone skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked this product from Kiehl's! It gently cleanses the skin without the feeling of dryness.The texture of the paste is not rough and is pleasant to apply leaving your skin clear and fresh.

I felt that this was a nice cleanser. Although my face did break out the first time I used it. However, as a face mask and an on-the-spot treatment, I didn't feel like it was very effective and the instructions on the bottle are only for using it as a cleanser. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have seen this brand a lot and I have always been interested in trying it out. With this product I love the many ways to use it, it makes traveling so much easier as it is 3 in 1. The drying paste is my favorite because it makes getting breakouts less stressful. I love that it has Salicylic Acid and natural ingredients. This product really does work!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This was an amazing product! I have sensitive skin so when I tell you this works it really does. I'm really insecure about my face cause I break out a lot and this has helped me a lot. It is a great product and it does not have a smell which I like. The packaging is great too.

avis.texte: I loved this product, it did super good for my face, for me it's a 10 out of 10, if you have problems with acne I highly recommend it, my sister also used it and had the same result as me, we both love this product

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love, love this cleanser. It so gentle on the skin and makes my skin look fresh. My acne has been reducing as well. It's a great addition to my skin care routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] they really nailed this product, feels like a old school clay mask but washes off like a traditional cleanser, I usually apply in the shower and let it sit for a moment then rinse off. My skin feels very clean, I would buy this again!

avis.titre: This is my new holy grail cleanser. 10/10 recommend!
avis.texte: Excited Review for Kiehl's Gently Effective Acne-Treating Cleansing Paste I am OBSESSED with this cleansing paste! 😍 The scent is super fresh and subtle — no overpowering fragrance, just a clean, natural smell that feels spa-like. The texture is thick and creamy, almost like a luxe clay mask, and spreads beautifully on the skin without feeling harsh or gritty. The effectiveness? INSANE. I noticed a visible reduction in breakouts within just a few days — thanks to the 2% salicylic acid and the amazing combo of charcoal, kaolin clay, and cica centella, which calm and detoxify my skin without drying it out. It's tough on acne but gentle on skin! Also, major shoutout to the packaging — sleek, no-mess tube with clean branding that looks premium on my shelf. 💚

avis.titre: Good product but a little pricey
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's Gentle on my sensitive skin and helped reduce breakouts over time (although I am on acne medication as well). I liked the creamy texture, no scent, and clean ingredients. The packaging is simple and travel-friendly. Took off one star because it's a bit pricey for the size, but overall worth trying.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My daughter and I really enjoyed this. We had a girls' night and did face masks. I absolutely loved the fact that this can be used in so many ways, especially spot treatment! The amount you get in the bottle is perfect. Overall, we really enjoyed this. I definitely recommend it.
This product is a must! Feels great on my skin and cleared my acne! Love how it is 3 in 1 and the bottle is eye catching. I will definitely continue using this product!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] KIEHL'S medicated 2% salicylic acid acne treatment works but there is a caveat! I recommend you start slow if you decide to use this. My skin is very sensitive and it started to break out and get really dry when I was following the "use twice daily" instructions. I had to wait for my face to clear up and slowly introduce it into my system. I'm about two weeks in and currently use it every other day in the evening, which seems to have made my acne breakouts significantly less frequent, aside from a few bumps here and there. Although I started slow, I am quite happy with the results so far and cannot wait to see what it will be like when I increase the frequency of use. I highly recommend this if you are dealing with acne!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Kiehl's Gently Effective Acne-Treating Cleansing Paste surprised me in the best way—it's one of the few acne products that actually feels calming while still doing the job. The earthy, slightly herbal scent fades fast, and the texture is thick but spreads easily on dry skin. I use it as a cleanser and sometimes leave it on for 5–10 minutes like a mini-mask, and within a week, the small white bumps and stubborn breakouts around my chin were visibly reduced. It has 2% salicylic acid, charcoal, and kaolin clay to fight acne, but thanks to glycerin and Centella, it never left my skin feeling dry or tight. The paste does have a slightly gritty texture, especially if left on longer, so I always follow with a good moisturizer. For the price and how quickly it works, it's totally worth it—and I like that it doubles as a spot treatment, too. If you're acne-prone but hate the stripped feeling from harsh acne products, this is a gentle but effective option that actually works.
great product, cleared up my skin in about 2 weeks. only a slight early smell from the clay. a little goes a long way and i definitely will be repurchasing!
i really like this product, works well and a little goes a long way, will be repurchasing again

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tend to have dry acne prone skin and I love this face wash . The texture is thick and does bubble slightly. It can be used as a mask or spot treatment as well as a face wash . The scent is a natural wet clay scent that I got used to very quickly . It didn't dry out my skin and prevented new break out . I will be repurchasing this product I love the versatility of it .
